'''Mangana aqua jewels''' were precious stones coveted by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The jewel was a brilliant, yellow-tinged gem that was found on the bottom of Naboo's major waterways. Gungan leaders, such as [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]], fitted their headpieces with a single egg-shaped mangana aqua jewel on top.
